title: Associate Senior Lecturer in Applied Geophysics
description: Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.The Applied Geophysics research group is part of the Division of Geoscience and Environmental Technology at the Department of Civil Engineering and Natural Resources in Luleå University of Technology. The department consists of approximately 400 employees, and research is conducted in the fields of geoscience, geoengineering, mining, metallurgy and civil engineering technology. The department has well-developed collaborations with research institutes, industrial partners and governmental agencies. The environment at the department is open, dynamic and brings together researchers as well as students from all over the world. It is one of the world’s longest standing research groups continuously active in mineral exploration and geoelectromagnetic studies. Subject description Applied Geophysics includes studies of how the laws and methods of physics can be used to understand the properties of bedrock and soil deposits. This includes development and applications of methods for exploration and investigation of natural resources such as mineral deposits and water, as well as investigation of environmental and infrastructural related issues. Duties Applied geophysics covers a wide range of geophysical methods and the assistant senior lecturer is expected to have the ability, interest and willingness to contribute to teaching of relevant methods. Collaboration with teachers in other geoscience disciplines is an integral part of the duties. Research-based teaching is seen as important to maintain high quality and to be in line with new developments in applied geophysics. Therefore, the assistant senior lecturer is expected to participate actively in research projects. These tasks means that you will:    Be responsible for developing, teaching and examining courses in applied geophysics, both at first and second cycle levels / at all study cycle levels. Supervise students and follow the subject's international development    Work with research tasks (e.g., applying for external research funding, leading and collaborating in research projects, data collection, communicating and disseminating research results via academic publications)    Network and collaborate with actors nationally and internationally    Be active in the applied geophysics research community.Qualifications To meet the requirements for the appointment as associate senior lecturer, the applicant:    must have been awarded a doctoral degree or must have a foreign degree considered equivalent to a doctoral degree. It must be within following areas:    Geophysics    Physics (with specialization in electromagnetism or computational physics) or a closely related numerically intensive discipline.The candidate should have completed a doctoral degree no more than five years before the end of the application period. A candidate that completed the doctoral degree earlier may apply if there are special reasons such as leave due to illness, parental leave, clinical service of trust, or similar circumstances. Assessment criteria The following assessment criteria apply to this position:    scientific expertise    other assessment criteria.Other assessment criteria is weighted equally:    ability to plan and perform geophysical fieldwork    the degree of expertise required for qualification    administrative proficiency that is of value in view of the subject matter and the duties included in the appointment    the ability to collaborate with the wider community    the ability to obtain external research and development funding    the ability to communicate research and development work    the ability to teach in Swedish and/or in EnglishPeriod of employment This position is for an employment period of four years. Promotion to senior lecturer An assistant senior lecturer shall, upon application, be promoted to senior lecturer on a permanent position. That the applicant is qualified for a position as senior lecturer and is deemed suitable for such a position in an examination, is determined in accordance with the assessment criteria set out below: In the examination, it is required that the associate senior lecturer has completed higher education pedagogical education corresponding to 7.5 credits or has acquired corresponding knowledge in another way. title: PhD student in plant development
description: Department of Forest Genetics and Plant PhysiologyThird-cycle subject areaBiologyDescription of the doctoral project The apical hook is a temporary organ structure that forms at the tip of the stem (hypocotyl) in darkness, aiding the germinating seedling as it emerges through the soil. Apical hook formation serves as an excellent model to study plant morphogenesis, as it involves distinct phases of growth promotion and inhibition. The phytohormone indole-3-acetic acid (IAA) is central to plant morphogenesis. This project focuses on investigating the modulation of auxin's spatiotemporal distribution in response to mechanochemical signals during development in Arabidopsis thaliana.About the positionThe research will utilize a range of approaches, including molecular biology techniques, cell biology methods (such as confocal and electron microscopy), mechncobiology experiments, physiological studies, proteomics, and genetic analysis.RequirementsTo meet the general entry requirements you must have:    been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification;    satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or    acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).    You must have equivalent knowledge to a minimum of 90 credits in biology-related subjects. This must include a degree project, and at least 30 credits must be at the advanced level.You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.Your profileThe applicant should have a strong interest in plant biology, molecular plant biology, mechanobiology or related fields. A background in cell and molecular biology is essential. Previous experience or expertise in mechanobiology or plant cell wall biology would be considered an advantage.The successful candidate should be highly motivated, driven and curious, with good interpersonal and communication skills. After an initial training period, they are expected to take increasing responsibility for their research, show initiative, and work independently, while continuing to receive guidance from their supervisor.Excellent oral and written communication skills in English are essential.Beyond academic qualifications, we place great importance on personal integrity, honesty, open communication and a collaborative attitude. We are looking for someone who is comfortable discussing both successes and difficulties, communicates openly about challenges and mistakes, takes responsibility for their work and contributes positively to a supportive and constructive research environment.About usThe Department of forest genetics and plant physiology is part of Umeå Plant Science Centre (UPSC, https://www.upsc.se/) which is a centre of excellence for experimental plant research and forest biotechnology in Northern Sweden. Our mission is to perform excellent and innovative basic research and generate knowledge that benefits forestry, agriculture, environment and society. We work across a wide range of disciplines in plant science reaching from cell biology to ecophysiology and from basic research to industrial applications. Our common goal is to understand the plants’ ability to grow, adapt and acclimate to a changing world and how we can breed better plants.Read more about staff benefits and life as an SLU employee on https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/ Read more about third-cycle courses and study programmes on http://www.slu.se/utbildning/program-kurser/forskarutbildning/Form of employment / Funding Employment as a doctoral student (4-year programme)Doctoral student’s salaries are set following the local collective agreement. Salary progression is fixed.Location: UmeåScope: 100%Start date: Upon agreement.Application and selection: Please submit your application using the link below. The deadline is 4 January 2027.Read more about the attachments that your application should include at https://www.slu.se/en/study/programmes-courses/doctoral-education/how-can-i-become-a-doctoral-student/application/Selection among eligible applicants is based on the documents attached to the application, and is carried out with regard to the applicant’s ability to complete the programme within the allotted time.Academic union representatives:https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/    The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

title: Rewarding Nursing Careers in Sweden's North
description: Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!Are you a dedicated nurse looking to take your skills to new heights while immersing yourself in the unique lifestyle of northern Europe?We’re seeking experienced general nurses to join healthcare teams across Northern Sweden – a region known for its stunning landscapes, tight-knit communities, and excellent working conditions.Why Northern Sweden?Northern Sweden offers more than just a job – it offers a lifestyle. Imagine finishing your shift and stepping out into fresh, clean air, surrounded by forests, lakes, and snow-capped mountains. This region is perfect for those who value space, calm, and a closer connection to nature. You’ll experience the beauty of the midnight sun in summer and the northern lights in winter – all while working in one of the most advanced healthcare systems in the world.About the role    As a general nurse, you will play a vital role in delivering compassionate, high-quality care in settings such as:    Regional hospitals, where teamwork and acute care go hand in hand    Health centers and outpatient clinics focused on continuity and community care    Administering treatments, supporting patient recovery, and contributing to care planning    Working alongside multidisciplinary teams to improve patient outcomes and innovate care deliveryWhat we’re looking for    EU-recognized nursing license and degree    Proficiency in English and readiness to learn Swedish    A flexible, team-oriented approach and solid nursing experience    A genuine passion for patient-centered careWhat you’ll get    Career development in a forward-thinking healthcare environment    Work-life balance that supports your well-being    Support throughout the process – from licensing to relocation    Free personalized Swedish language training via Teams or Skype    Assistance with accommodation and family relocation, if neededCurious about life in the North?Let’s talk. We’re happy to tell you more about the region, the roles, and how we support you every step of the way. Apply today to stay in the loop about upcoming opportunities for nurses across Sweden.You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

title: Cluster Manager - Data Center Engineering
description: AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.  You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, and operations managers. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.  The Infrastructure Operations organization is seeking an exceptional leader to serve as a Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Cluster Manager in Sweden. You will lead a large organization managing multiple data centers in the cluster, overseeing managers responsible for critical facility infrastructure.  The pace, scale, and growth of Amazon's data center platform will challenge you. We seek experienced senior leaders who are highly strategic in managing their business unit, yet lead by example and roll up their sleeves when required.  The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of data center and mission-critical MEP infrastructure. You will be responsible for maintaining 100% service uptime in our cluster, maintaining a high-level view while diving deep into details as needed. You will interact daily with global teams, representing Sweden Data Center Engineering Operations.  If you are passionate about customer experience, think and act globally, and want to contribute to the operational excellence of AWS data centers, this is the challenge you've been looking for. Key job responsibilities  Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and develop the operations management team including Facility Managers, Chief Engineers, and Facility Technicians. Mentor and develop employees at all levels, including managers.  Operational Excellence: Ensure operation and maintenance of mechanical, electrical, and controls systems for AWS data centers, including preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, and change management. Maintain 100% service uptime across your cluster.  Performance Management: Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of critical facility operations and maintenance. Manage all facility-related repairs in a timely manner.  Organizational Structure: Build and maintain a sustainable organizational structure. Develop hiring strategy and participate in recruiting events.  Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with business development, engineering, and construction teams to forecast staffing needs and maintain appropriate resource levels.  Vendor Management: Manage colocation data center service providers to meet or exceed contracted performance SLAs. Oversee on-site management of shift technicians, senior shift technicians, sub-contractors, and vendors, ensuring all work is performed in accordance with established practices and procedures.  Incident Management: Lead safety, security, and availability incident response, incident management, incident resolution, and root cause analysis.  Financial Management: Manage cost including OPEX and CAPEX associated with all data centers under your responsibility.  Reporting & Communication: Conduct daily/weekly/monthly Data Center Engineering Operations meetings and reporting. Run weekly availability meetings and report outcomes.  Global Integration: Liaise with global teams on initiatives, processes, and procedures; implement those initiatives locally in Sweden.  Continuous Improvement: Drive continuous improvement of operational processes, procedures, methods, and tools. Lead and manage energy efficiency initiatives in your cluster.  Capacity Planning: Support capacity planning and management activities. About the team  You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.Basic qualifications    Experience hiring, developing, and managing high-performing technical teams.    4+ years of experience operating as a manager of managers AND/OR 7+ years of relevant experience managing mission-critical facilities.    In-depth knowledge of data center facilities such as generators, chillers, cooling towers, air handling units, UPS, electrical sub-distribution systems, fire detection and suppression systems, and cable reticulation systems.    Fluency in English to communicate effectively with global teams.    Driving license valid in EU.Preferred qualifications    Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering or related fields.    Experience managing or implementing system health, performance monitoring, capacity planning, or process improvement and automation.    Experience supporting procedures for production or mission-critical environments including ticketing, monitoring/metrics, and troubleshooting technical issues.    Fluency in Swedish.

title: Finance Migration Expert
description: Assignment context & TeamThe customer will launch a multi-year S/4HANA program across 150 legal entities in 6 European countries. The goal is to harmonize and standardize finance processes across regions (Nordics, Netherlands, Germany). The project go-live is planned in May 2027.For this project and after the go-live, the customer needs someone in the team who can collaborate with the key users to the Design and Migration Concept Guide and to execute the business and IT in mapping activities.The consultant will join the Financial Solutions team within IT, you’ll work closely with the project team consisting of theIT team that is performing the execution and the business team which is knowledgeable in the day-to-day accounting processes.As a SAP S/4H Finance Migration Expert you play a critical client-facing role and will show the ability to clearly articulate the business value and change impact of S/4HANA Finance Transformations. In 2026 January, the customer went live with the Greenfield S/4Hana project implementation. Currently they are rolling out the global template. This assignment is consisting of One Business Unit which is part of the this roll-out phase. In this assignment you are able to articulate the benefits of new SAP S/4Hana and interpret Business and Legal requirements and translate these into the current Global Template solution with focus on Asset Accounting including the following tasks :    Deep SAP Finance knowledge is a must.    Solid understanding of integration with related modules and business processes.    Strong analytical and conceptual skills.    Self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, able to drive topics independently.    Delivered similar migration cycles is a must    English language is mandatory, Swedish language a plus You bring a strong SAP ECC & S/4Hana Finance background and act as a subject matter expert in SAP. You provide direction to the migration team and ensure business alignment.Could this be the right assignment for you?Apply today or contact us to learn more about this opportunity. Please submit your application, including a CV and cover letter in Swedish, highlighting how your experience and qualifications meet our client's requirements.Our client may make a decision before the application deadline, as applications are reviewed and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.NXT Interim and NXT Recruitment specialise in providing innovative consultancy and recruitment solutions.With over 20 years of industry experience, we operate across HR, IT, Finance, Sales and Marketing. We offer our consultants a range of attractive benefits, including health insurance, remote working facilities and additional perks designed to enhance their everyday working lives.All employment contracts are governed by collective bargaining agreements.

title: Principal Server Engineer
description: Do you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and shaping the architecture of games played by millions?As a Principal Server Engineer at Snowprint, you are part of a game team, designing, developing and operating the game. You'll combine hands-on development with long-term technical vision. Everything you do impacts the player experience and how we build games.At Snowprint Studios, we believe that kindness, collaboration, curiosity, and taking ownership are what make great games possible. We work in small, cross-disciplinary teams where people are trusted to take responsibility, share ideas openly, and continuously improve how we build games together.What you’ll be doingTogether with the team, you'll shape the architecture and technical direction of our backend systems, designing and implementing solutions that support both current game features and future needs. You'll take the lead on complex technical features.You'll work on both player-facing features and the systems, tooling and infrastructure behind them. This includes evolving our existing architecture, identifying opportunities for improvement, and ensuring our backend solutions remain scalable, maintainable, efficient and secure as our games grow.You'll also play an important role in the technical development of the team. Working closely with other developers, you'll share knowledge, challenge ideas, provide technical guidance and help establish good practices. You'll collaborate with designers and other disciplines to ensure that technical decisions support both development needs and the player experience.Is this you?    You're a highly experienced server/backend engineer with a strong background in designing, building, and operating complex backend systems. You're fluent in Kotlin and/or Java.    You have experience shaping backend architecture and making technical decisions that balance immediate requirements with long-term scalability and maintainability.    You're comfortable taking ownership of cloud infrastructure and have hands-on experience operating cloud environments.    You have extensive experience with live services and understand the demands of keeping a game running. You're comfortable troubleshooting production issues, adapting to changing priorities, and finding solutions when things don't go as planned.    You're a strong technical voice who enjoys sharing knowledge, challenging ideas, and helping others grow. You communicate clearly, collaborate well and can explain complex technical decisions to people from different disciplines.Where you’ll workOur Stockholm studio is located in Södermalm, and we work in a hybrid setup. We work from the office on Tuesdays and Fridays to support collaboration and social interaction, while other days offer flexibility depending on where you work best. We provide the setup and tools you need to work comfortably both at home and in the studio.About Snowprint StudiosSnowprint Studios believes great games are created by teams of talented, kind and creative individuals in a friendly, supportive and inspiring environment - while maintaining a sustainable life-work balance. For more information on Snowprint Studios go to snowprintstudios.com and follow us on Facebook.At Snowprint Studios, we embrace diversity both in the worlds we create and in our workplace. Join us in shaping the future of gaming!    Pocket Gamer Awards Winner ‘Mobile game of the year’ and ‘Best strategy game’ 2022    Pocket Gamer Awards Winner 'Best game we are still playing’ 2024 & 2026    Pocket Gamer Awards Finalist, ‘Best developer’ 2025    Pocket Gamer Awards Winner, ‘Best updated game’ & ‘Best community’ 2026Good to knowWe are an international company with many nationalities represented. Our company language is English, so your application should therefore be in English.

title: Lead Developer
description: Looking for a workplace for the future?We are looking for a Lead developer for our Online Sales team, enabling all digital sales journeys on Telenor.se. You will guide and lead highly skilled developers operating in a complex landscape; balancing team growth, AI adoption, technical evolution, and customer experience improvements. We are looking for someone who holds a deep conceptual understanding of frontend software development, but you will also be expected to do hands-on work yourself. We believe the correct person for this role and team is both a leader, mentor and a doer.How you’ll make a difference with us    Leadership: You will be accountable for the technical excellence of the team, including code quality. However, there are many ways to lead and at Telenor we promote strength-based leadership and servant leadership.     Team Management & Growth: At Telenor we believe we are Better Together. You're expected to help your colleagues learn and grow, for example through individual feedback, mentoring and pair programming.     Stability & reliability: Telenor provides services that are vital for our society. Because of this an important responsibility for this role to ensure stable, resilient and secure platforms.     In-team collaboration: You'll be one of the informal leaders of the team, together with the Agile Team Lead and the Product Owner, whom you'll be expected to collaborate closely with.     Cross-team collaboration: You'll work closely with architects, UX, content creators and other development teams. Are you the one we’re looking for?We are looking for someone comfortable working with most of our current technologies, who can work within our architectural principles and help evolve them through thoughtful discussion and practical experience. We are looking for someone familiar with the following technologies.Frontend Development    Strong expertise in TypeScript, JavaScript and frontend frameworks (e.g. Vue).     Microfrontend architectures and components patterns.     Design Systems, component libraries.    Responsive design and browser compatibility. Backend Development    Strong expertise in .NET/C# web application development.     Third-party system integrations (REST APIs and GraphQL).     Headless CMS architecture (Contentful).  Testing & Quality    TDD and quality-first development.     Clean code, maintainability and engineering best practices. Cloud, DevOps & Observability     Cloud platforms (AWS).     Distributed caching strategies (Redis).     CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).     Observability and performance analysis (ELK, Splunk, Elastic APM). Accessibility     WCAG, semantic HTML and inclusive design.     Accessibility testing and compliance. Security    Security best practices.     Secure coding and privacy by design. Good-to-have    E-commerce and digital sales flows.    Feature management and experimentation platforms.     AI-assisted software development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code). Our promise to you! We are better together. Here, you’ll join an inclusive, family-like culture where shared values and empowering leadership build trust, confidence, and mutual support.We support relationships and societies. Telenor serves society by creating value for millions daily, putting customers and human relationships first.We make room for life. Work remotely up to two days a week when your role allows, and collaborate at the office otherwise. Enjoy two extra days off yearly, flexible hours, and benefits for every life stage, including collective agreements, pensions, wellness allowances, and tailored insurance.Move your career forward. Your growth is central to our culture. We dedicate at least 40 hours yearly to learning through Telenor Academy and other initiatives, helping you build expertise, explore new areas, and advance your career across the Nordics.Apply today!At Telenor we offer an environment with a high pace of change, great colleagues and lots of opportunities for learning and growth. Apply now!If you have any questions or want to know more, feel free to contact the hiring manager Jakob Grefbäck at jakob.grefback@telenor.se . Please note that we cannot accept applications via email.

title: Senior Credit & Risk Analyst
description: Company description:"Founded in 1927, the Volvo Group is committed to driving prosperity and shaping the future landscape through sustainable transport, mobility, and infrastructure solutions. By offering trucks, buses, construction equipment, power solutions for marine and industrial applications, financing and services that increase our customers’ uptime and productivity. Our headquarters are in Gothenburg, Sweden. Volvo Group shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm."Job description:     About the role:    Are you an experienced credit professional with a strong analytical mindset and the ability to independently assess complex credit risks? Do you enjoy combining financial analysis and risk management with digital development and continuous improvement? Are you motivated by taking ownership, influencing decisions, and contributing to a strong credit culture? Then this could be the opportunity for you!At Volvo Financial Services, we are looking for a Senior Credit & Risk Analyst to strengthen our team in Gothenburg. In this role, you will play a key part in assessing and managing credit risk, supporting sound business decisions, and continuously improving the way we work. You will combine hands-on credit analysis with portfolio controlling, reporting, and the development of smarter, more scalable solutions.     What you will do   As Senior Credit & Risk Analyst, you will take an independent role in assessing complex credit cases and providing well-founded recommendations to support business decisions. You will prepare credit applications for larger transactions presented to relevant Credit Committees, ensuring high-quality financial analysis and clear recommendation rationale.You will also underwrite new business within your individual credit delegation and act as a voting member of various Credit Committees. Through your expertise and judgement, you will contribute to maintaining a sound risk balance while supporting the business and its customers. Beyond your core credit responsibilities, you will play an important role in developing and improving our credit and risk processes. You will drive the development and implementation of automated and scalable credit analysis and reporting solutions, leveraging AI, Power BI, and other data and analytics tools. You will also contribute to the design and maintenance of Swedish underwriting directives and procedures, ensuring alignment with relevant internal and external frameworks. In addition, you will support monthly and quarterly Credit & Risk reporting and contribute to the continuous quality assurance of our processes. We are a small team where collaboration, flexibility, and a willingness to support one another are essential. This means being comfortable taking ownership of your responsibilities while also contributing to other activities and tasks across the team when needed.     Who are you?   You are a proactive and structured professional who enjoys taking ownership and driving things forward independently. You have a strong analytical mindset and the confidence to make sound credit assessments, even in complex situations. You are comfortable challenging assumptions, identifying potential risks, and translating financial data into clear and well-founded recommendations.You combine strong financial and analytical capabilities with a genuine interest in digitalization and innovation. You are curious about how new technologies, particularly AI, can improve the way we work, and you enjoy identifying opportunities to make processes more efficient, automated, and scalable. As a person, you are collaborative and business-oriented. You understand the importance of balancing risk management with commercial priorities and maintaining a strong focus on customers. You communicate clearly, involve relevant stakeholders, and enjoy working together to achieve shared results. You thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where being flexible, solution-oriented, and willing to learn is just as important as your technical expertise. To join us, we see that you have:• A university degree or MBA in Finance, Controlling, or a related field, or equivalent experience.• Solid experience in hands-on credit risk assessment and management within the financial services industry.• The ability to independently conduct complex credit analyses and provide well-founded credit recommendations.• Strong financial analysis and quantitative skills, with the ability to assess financial statements and evaluate credit risk.• Strong digital capabilities and experience using data and analytics tools, with an interest in incorporating AI into credit analysis and everyday workflows.• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both English and Swedish.• Strong organizational skills, a proactive approach, and the ability to manage your own responsibilities independently.• A collaborative mindset, with the ability to coordinate, involve, and work effectively with different stakeholders.     Ready for the next move?   Last Application Date: December 8th 2026    We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

title: Researcher in Applied Geophysics
description: Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.We are recruiting a Researcher to work primarily in the European Plate Observing System (EPOS) project related to developing research infrastructure to archive and access geoscientific data. You will also be involved in other projects as well teaching Exploration geophysics courses. Take the opportunity to work in interdisciplinary, dynamic, international research environment in close collaboration with industry and leading universities worldwide. Subject description Applied Geophysics includes studies of how the laws and methods of physics can be used to understand the properties of bedrock and soil deposits. This includes development and applications of methods for exploration and investigation of natural resources such as mineral deposits and water, as well as investigation of environmental and infrastructural related issues. Project description The pan-European “European Plate Observing System (EPOS)” distributed e-infrastructure is a long-term sustainable solution for the collection, securing, dissemination and analysis of data related to the solid Earth and the processes forming the solid Earth and surface.  One of the core services of the project is Geoelectromagnetic observations Thematic Core Service TCS. TCS Geoelectromanetic Observations is responsible for the provision of data about the geomagnetic field between the Earth’s core and space. The EMTDAMO (the European Service of Magnetotluric Data and Models) service was introduced for data that determine the electrical resistivity of the Earth’s subsurface by measuring the response on natural time variations of the Earth's magnetic and electric fields. Luleå University of Technology is responsible for EMTDAMO, which will collect data from various sources as the basis for new and improved resistivity models of the Earth. Duties Within the EPOS project you will be working on archiving of EM data, which involves development and management of databases. A big part of your working time will be devoted to project and data management and communication with TCS partners. The position responsibilities also include both field work (to collect new data) and theoretical/development work as well as communicating your results at national and international conferences and in scientific journals. You will work primarily with electromagnetic data with focus on magnetotelluric observations. 3D geophysical data modelling/inversion is also important element of work duties, especially when being involved in other projects run at Luleå University of Technology. You are expected to work on our in-house development of modelling/inversion framework. In addition, you will have to teacher courses as well as co-supervise PhD students. As a researcher, you work as a neutral party in many contexts, which provides a great opportunity to be involved in challenging development projects. Qualifications In order to be eligible for employment as a Researcher you must have a PhD or equivalent degree in Geophysics, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, or another relevant field, awarded no more than three years before the application deadline for this position. You must also have an academic record, experience in software development (Python, Matlab and Web development in particular) and management of large data sets are required. Good understanding of theory and numerical methods used in modelling and inversion are important. You are expected to work in a team and are open to collaborate with colleagues and external partners. Fluent written and spoken English is required. Most employees in the research subject exploration geophysics are currently men therefore provided that the qualifications are the same, the underrepresented gender will be given priority. Further information This employment as Researcher is set to 75% and is limited to 1 year. Placement: Luleå. Starting date: 2027-01-01 or as soon as possible. You will also contribute to technical decisions, support less experienced colleagues, and bring the experimental perspective into discussions about future research priorities.Your Key Responsibilities:    Translate scientific objectives into experimental approaches and measurement plans.    Provide technical guidance during the preparation, execution, and evaluation of experimental campaigns.    Develop and apply analysis methods that help explain observed plasma behaviour.    Assess experimental results using relevant physical models, detector principles, and simulation tools.    Recommend improvements to diagnostic capabilities, measurement methods, and experimental procedures.    Take ownership of scientific and technical challenges, working independently and together with other specialists.    Support junior colleagues through practical guidance and knowledge sharing.    Contribute to discussions about the direction and priorities of our client’s experimental research.Who You Are:We are looking for a senior physicist who enjoys working close to experiments and investigating complex scientific problems. You combine analytical depth with a practical approach and can move between detailed technical work and broader research questions.You are proactive, collaborative, and willing to support colleagues across different disciplines. You are comfortable making independent technical assessments and adapting your approach as new experimental findings emerge.We believe you have:    Several years of relevant experience in experimental physics, with the ability to independently address complex experimental challenges.    A strong practical background in designing experiments and developing, implementing, and applying physics data analysis methods.    Experience interpreting experimental observations through an understanding of the underlying physics, detector behaviour, and relevant simulations.    Hands-on experience with linear plasma devices.    The ability to take technical responsibility and contribute scientific expertise within a multidisciplinary team.It is considered a plus if you also have:    A PhD in plasma physics, experimental physics, or a related discipline, supported by scientific publications.    Experience developing software for plasma research or scientific data analysis.    Experience working in collaborative laboratory settings where priorities and experimental needs evolve.    Experience supporting the development of junior researchers or engineers.Your expertise may cover one or more of the following areas:    Plasma instabilities, transport, heating, and fueling.    Operation and diagnostics of linear plasma systems, including mirror and cusp configurations.    Optical and particle diagnostics, such as spectroscopy, interferometry, tomography, imaging, probes, and particle detection.    Diagnostic calibration and the effects of plasma exposure on measurement equipment.    Plasma-surface interactions, including wall conditioning, erosion, and deposition.    Analysis of time-dependent signals using spectral, filtering, correlation, and statistical methods.    Numerical modelling and simulation of plasma phenomena using relevant scientific software.Application Process:Intertalents Consulting AB is managing this recruitment on behalf of our client. We review applications and conduct interviews continuously, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The position may be filled before the application deadline.The start date will be agreed upon with our client. A background check may form part of the recruitment process.What We Offer:Through this recruitment, we offer the opportunity to join a technically advanced environment at our client, where experimental research contributes to the development of future energy solutions.You will collaborate with specialists from different scientific and engineering disciplines and have the opportunity to influence experimental methods, share your expertise, and contribute to the team’s continued development.The position is permanent and full-time, based in Stockholm. Some flexibility for remote work is available, although most of the work takes place at our client’s office and laboratory facilities. We welcome applications from candidates in Sweden and abroad. Relocation support may be available where needed.Diversity & Inclusion:At Intertalents, we welcome applications regardless of gender, nationality, background, or ethnicity. We value a broad range of experiences and perspectives and work to support an inclusive recruitment process.

title: Regualtory Affairs Specialist Getinge Incfection control
description: Company description:Getinge is a leading global provider of products and systems that contribute to quality enhancement and cost efficiency within healthcare and life sciences. We employ more than 10,000 people, and have operations in more than 40 countries. Saving lives is the greatest job in the world. Everything we do, from architectural planning to the equipment, therapies and solutions aim to secure the safest and most reliable care. As a leading medtech company, we focus every talent and resource towards helping our customers save as many lives as possible.Job description:About this opportunity   As Regulatory Affairs Specialist at Getinge Disinfection, you provide regulatory compliance and ensure successful product compliance for R&D and sustaining projects and changes. You also perform and support product registrations and improve the process. You report to the Regulatory Affairs Manager and work closely with R&D, Technical Support, Production, Sourcing and management, as well as with the Regulatory and Product Compliance organization and authorities in different countries. In this role, your primary responsibility will be to provide regulatory compliance and ensure successful product compliance for R&D and sustaining projects and changes. What you will do As a Regulatory Affairs Specialist at Getinge, you will play an important role in ensuring that our medical devices meet regulatory requirements throughout their lifecycle, from product development to market registration and post-market changes. Your main tasks will include:     Prepare, compile, review, and support regulatory submissions for new product registrations, renewals, and amendments across international markets.     Maintain existing regulatory approvals, licenses, and registrations and ensure renewals and regulatory updates are completed on time.     Develop and support regulatory strategies for new product development projects, working closely with R&D, Quality, and other cross-functional teams.     Assess the regulatory impact of product and design changes, including engineering change requests and change control activities     Review and maintain regulatory technical documentation, including technical files, Design History Files (DHF), risk management documentation, and verification and validation records     Monitor changes in international medical-device regulations, standards, and guidance and assess potential impact to existing and future products.     Support regulatory information management systems and maintain accurate product registration data     Review and approve product labeling, Instructions for Use (IFUs), and marketing materials to ensure regulatory compliance. This position is located in Växjö with the possibility to work 1-2 days from home. The role may require domestic and international travel. You will bring To be successful in this position, we believe that you have the following qualifications.     Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Management or a related discipline.     Experience in Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, product development, or a related function within the medical device industry or another regulated environment.     Experience with regulatory submissions, technical documentation, product registrations, or change control activities.     Strong knowledge of applicable regulations and standards, e.g. ISO 13485, ISO 14971, MDR     Good Swedish and English skills, orally and written     Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities     Good communication skills and the ability to work well in cross-functional teams In addition to your technical skills, we highly value your personality. You think strategically but pragmatically and are able to make decisions. You work independently and can take quick decisions within your area of responsibility. We think you have an ambition for growth and an eagerness for keeping up to date with the latest in medical device regulations and standards. At Getinge we see ourselves as proactive and self-driven in learning and contributing to the continued development of our products and our organization's capabilities.  We are Team Players, Forward Thinkers and Game Changers.   We think you will thrive in a high-expectation environment and have an interest in our products.   Application   Applications will be reviewed continually, and we therefore recommend sending us your application as soon as possible, but no later than 2026-12-30 We kindly ask you to submit your application in our recruitment system by clicking the “apply now” button. Due to GDPR regulations we do not accept applications via e-mail. If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact Hiring Manager Mohammad Fazel at email: mohammad.fazel@getinge.com  or Talent Partner Emma Paulsson at emma.paulsson@getinge.com. We look forward to receiving your application. We hope you will join us on our journey to become the world’s most desired MedTech company.

title: Responsable Conformité
description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Responsable Conformité (100%) --- Responsable Conformité (100%) ============================== L'Office cantonal des assurances sociales est une institution autonome de droit public et constitue un pôle de compétences dans les assurances sociales du 1er pilier. Il gère et coordonne quatre régimes d'assurance : assurance\\-vieillesse et survivants, assurance\\-invalidité, allocations familiales et allocations pour perte de gain. Pour relever les défis actuels, l'OCAS est à la recherche d'un\\-e \*\*Responsable conformité\*\* (100 %) Classe de fonction 23 Au sein du domaine des services partagés et rattaché\\-e au responsable adjoint du domaine, vous avez pour mission de construire et piloter le nouveau secteur conformité de l'OCAS. Vous donnez à l'institution une vue unique de sa maîtrise en matière de gestion des risques, de contrôle interne, de qualité, de sécurité de l'information et de protection des données. Pour ce faire, vous réunissez et développez les dispositifs existants que la loi impose aux organes d'exécution du 1er pilier. Dans un contexte réglementaire exigeant et en évolution, vous priorisez selon les risques que l'institution doit maîtriser. Dans une logique de deuxième ligne de maîtrise, vous élaborez et déployez progressivement le cadre méthodologique, accompagnez la mise en œuvre par les secteurs et les domaines, qui restent responsables de leurs risques, et contrôlez l'efficacité du dispositif. Vous rendez compte de l'état de maîtrise à la direction générale et à la commission risques du conseil d'administration. Vous conduisez une équipe de deux spécialistes en sécurité de l'information et en protection des données. Ce poste s'adresse à une personnalité fédératrice et résolue, dotée d'un bon esprit de synthèse, capable de faire appliquer des exigences de maîtrise sans se substituer aux métiers. \*\*Vos différentes missions\*\* \* Construire et piloter le secteur conformité et y faire vivre une culture de travail alignée sur les valeurs et les principes directeurs de l'OCAS \* Assurer la pérennité de la vision et de l'organisation du secteur en anticiper les évolutions légales et réglementaires \* Définir le cadre de maîtrise de l'institution en matière de gestion des risques, de contrôle interne, de qualité, de sécurité de l'information et de protection des données, en accompagner la mise en œuvre par les secteurs et en contrôler l'efficacité \* Conduire et développer une équipe composée d'un chargé de la sécurité de l'information et d'un juriste spécialisé en protection des données \* Être l'interlocuteur / interlocutrice de la commission risques du conseil d'administration, de l'OFAS, de l'organe de révision et des autorités de protection des données, pour le compte de la direction générale \* Construire par étapes un système de management intégré, piloté par les risques \* Tenir la cartographie des risques et animer le réseau des répondants \* Piloter le système de contrôle interne, suivre les remédiations et prévenir la fraude \* Porter le système de management de la qualité et l'articuler avec la transformation et l'amélioration continue \* Superviser la sécurité de l'information et la protection des données, et assurer le rôle de répondant LIPAD \* Tenir le registre des prescriptions, en contrôler la mise en œuvre et assurer la veille légale et normative \* Rendre compte chaque année de l'état de maîtrise à la commission risques et tenir, pour la direction générale, ### **Installateur sanitaire expérimenté \- dépannage**

 

### **Introduction**

Une entreprise reconnue dans le domaine du sanitaire à Genève, recherche un Installateur Sanitaire spécialisé dans le dépannage. Si vous êtes passionné par votre métier et souhaitez rejoindre une équipe dynamique et professionnelle, cette opportunité est faite pour vous !

* Effectuer des interventions de dépannage et de maintenance sur les installations sanitaires.
* Diagnostiquer les pannes et proposer des solutions adaptées.
* Installer, réparer et entretenir les équipements sanitaires (robinetterie, chauffe\-eau, conduites, etc.).
* Assurer la maintenance d'un immeuble, et débouchage.
* Garantir un service de qualité et veiller à la satisfaction des clients.
* Respecter les normes de sécurité et les réglementations en vigueur.


### Votre profil

* Titulaire d’un CFC d'installateur sanitaire ou expérience jugée équivalente dans une entreprise suisse.
* Expérience confirmée dans le domaine du dépannage de plus de 5 ans dans la même entreprise suisse.
* Bonne connaissance des normes suisses en matière d'installations sanitaires.
* Expérience concluante dans un service 7/7 jour et 24/24h.
* Capacité à travailler de manière autonome et à gérer les priorités.
* Excellentes compétences relationnelles et sens du service client.
* Permis de conduire valable en Suisse.


### Ce que nous offrons

* Un environnement de travail dynamique et convivial.
* Des projets variés et stimulants.
* Une rémunération compétitive adaptée au marché genevois et des avantages sociaux attractifs.
* Des opportunités de formation continue et de développement professionnel.
* Un équipement moderne et des outils de qualité.


### Informations pour postuler

Si ce poste vous intéresse et que vous souhaitez rejoindre notre équipe, nous vous invitons à postuler dès maintenant. Nous avons hâte de découvrir votre candidature et de vous accompagner dans votre prochain défi professionnel.

title: Research Ethics Compliance Officer Sensitive Data
description: Ref 2592631 \\\| Date: 23 Nov 2026 !\[EPFL\]( ) EPFL, the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne, is one of the most dynamic university campuses in Europe and ranks among the top 20 universities worldwide. The EPFL employs more than 6,500 people supporting the three main missions of the institution: education, research and innovation. The EPFL campus offers an exceptional working environment at the heart of a community of more than 17,000 people, including over 12,500 students and 4,000 researchers from more than 120 different countries. Research Ethics Compliance Officer Sensitive Data \*\*Mission\*\* The EPFL Research Office (ReO) is seeking a Research Ethics Compliance Officer to support EPFL's research community with ethics compliance and governance aspects of research projects that are within the scope of the Swiss Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings and the Federal Data Protection Act. This position will also support the establishment and implementation of (i) EPFL's Trusted Research Environment (TRE) "" an ISO 27001\\-certified infrastructure for the processing of sensitive data, with a focus on health\\-related data "" and (ii) the institutional biobank. The candidate is an individual with proven competence in ethics compliance related to scientific research (incl. with health\\-related data and human samples). She/he will have excellent communication skills and the ability to work in a dynamic team. \*\*Main duties and responsibilities\*\* Support EPFL principal investigators and ReO Programme Managers in ensuring ethics and regulatory compliance \* Advise researchers on the applicable ethics and regulatory framework for research involving human participants, human biological samples, and personal/sensitive data. \* Assess the applicability of the Swiss Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings (HRA) and its Ordinances, the Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP), and other Swiss or international requirements, in collaboration with Legal Affairs. \* Guide researchers through appropriate ethics approval procedures and support applications to Cantonal ethics committees. \* Review submissions for quality and completeness and support amendments, renewals and project closures. \* Act as point of contact between researchers and Cantonal ethics committees or other relevant authorities (FOPH, FOEN, etc.) and support follow\\-up on their requirements. Develop guidance documents, resources, training and awareness\\-raising initiatives \* Contribute to institutional procedures and SOPs for research involving human participants, human biological samples, and personal and sensitive data, particularly health\\-related data. \* Develop practical guidance and resources and promote good practices in human research through training and awareness\\-raising activities. Provide support on specific ethics compliance and regulatory questions \* Provide tailored advice on ethics and regulatory questions throughout the lifecycle of projects within the scope of the HRA, FADP. \* Advise on regulatory aspects of human biological sample transfers and redirect researchers to Legal Affairs and TTO for relevant agreements. \* Coordinate with Legal Affairs, TTO, DPO, Library, IT services, Biosafety officers and DSPS on cross\\-cutting regulatory matters. \* Contribute to institutional ethics compliance procedures and positions on emerging regulatory questions, in collaboration with relevant services. Provide ethics compliance input and support for the development and implementation of EPFL's institutional framework for the management of sensitive research data (focus: health\\-related data) and biological samples \* Contribute to the roadmap for EPFL's sensitive/human research data framework, in collaboration with the Institutional Coordinator Human Research Infrastructure and relevant institutional units (Legal Affairs, DPO, IT, etc.). \* Develop internal governance frameworks, workflows/SOPs, tools and guidance for the ethics/legal compliance of projects involving sensitive research data and/or biological samples. \* Ensure ethics compliance and governance requirements for EPFL's biobank infrastructure, including governance regulations, consent documentation and procedures, and certification processes ( SBP Label or ISO). \* Obtain ethics authorization for the EPFL biobank infrastructure, including preparation and submission of the application and interactions with the Cantonal Ethics Committee. Support the activities of the EPFL Human Research Ethics Committee (HREC) \* Provide regulatory and administrative support for the review and follow\\-up of research protocols involving humans that fall outside the HRA but require HREC approval. Support other tasks within the ReO/Ethics Affairs \* Maintain an institutional overview of HRA protocols where EPFL acts as sponsor, partner or participant, including authorizations, amendments, renewals and closures. \* Collaborate with relevant internal services on cross\\-cutting ethics compliance and regulatory matters. \* Support other Ethics Affairs activities as required. \*\*Profile\*\* \* Master's degree in a relevant field, such as law (specialization human research), public health, life sciences, biomedical sciences or related field (additional certifications and licenses in relation to ethics compliance, biobanking and data protection will be considered a strong asset). \* Solid knowledge and expertise about the ethics compliance framework and of the ethics compliance and governance requirements in Switzerland (Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings and the Federal Data Protection Act (FADP) and their application). \* Knowledge about management of human biological samples, human subjects/clinical research data, clinical trials, and biobanks. \* Extensive experience with the preparation and submission of ethics applications to the Cantonal Ethics Committees. \* Ability to analyse and understand research projects in relation to the Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings and the FADP. \* Ability to explain the ethics compliance regulations on research involving humans, personal/sensitive data, biological samples, etc. to researchers who are not necessarily familiar with this area of work. \* Experience in preparing and developing ethics compliance related guidance documents and tools/resources for a broad audience. \* Excellent collaboration skills to conduct joint projects and to liaise with internal and external stakeholders (such as legal affairs, cantonal ethics commissions, etc.). \* Good organization skills, and the ability to set priorities and meet deadlines. \* The ability to work both independently and in a team, and to adapt to the individual needs of EPFL principal investigators. \* Excellent collaboration skills to conduct joint projects and to liaise with internal and external stakeholders (such as legal affairs, DPO, IT, Cantonal ethics commissions, etc.). \* Strong writing, editing and proofreading skills in English. \*\*We offer\*\* \* A dynamic and cosmopolitan work environment in a multidisciplinary institution. \* Competitive salary, remote working may be possible for a portion of the time. \* The opportunity of continuous training and development according to the requirements of the function. At EPFL, we believe that people achieve great results when they feel supported, respected and enabled to succeed. By joining our community, you will help shape the future of society through education, research and innovation. We offer an inspiring, international and collaborative environment where your work has real impact and your ideas are valued. Combined with flexible ways of working and attractive employment conditions, we aim to create an environment where everyone can contribute, grow and make a difference. Beyond work, our campuses host a vibrant community and unique environment, enriched by initiatives promoting equality, inclusion, diversity, well\\-being and sustainability as well as an engaging program of cultural, sports and community activities throughout the year. \[Read about our employment conditions and employee benefits\](\< \> " ") \*\*Informations\*\* Contract Start Date : Activity Rate Min : Activity Rate Max : Contract Type: CDD Duration: one year Reference: 2606 jpid4c643c1jm jpit1148jm jpiy26jm

Chef\-fe de projet immobilier
=============================

**GEFISWISS** est spécialisé dans la gestion de fonds d’investissement immobiliers. L'entreprise se concentre sur l'acquisition et la valorisation de terrains à bâtir afin de développer des projets à fort impact économique, social et environnemental. Sa mission consiste ainsi à créer de la valeur pour ses investisseurs tout en s'engageant activement pour un développement urbain responsable et tourné vers l'avenir. Son ADN repose sur une approche entrepreneuriale et responsable, guidée par l’engagement ainsi que la recherche de valeur durable. Pour soutenir notre équipe, nous recherchons un\-e


**Chef\-fe de projet immobilier**

Vos tâches principales :

Piloter et coordonner les projets immobiliers de la planification à la réception ainsi que le suivi des travaux de éfinir les objectifs, programmes, plannings, ressources et budgets des projets et en assurer le suivi.Coordonner les mandants, mandataires, entreprises et intervenants internes et externes afin de garantir le bon déroulement des opé les coûts, délais, qualité et principaux indicateurs des projets, identifier les écarts et mettre en œuvre les mesures correctives nécessaires.Veiller au respect des exigences réglementaires, des autorisations et des objectifs de rentabilité définis par la Direction.

 

Vous serez également amené à :

Préparer les reportings à destination de la Direction et des mandants en présentant les réalisations, écarts, risques, opportunités et décisions requises.Optimiser l’allocation du temps et des ressources, assurer le suivi des prestations réalisées et leur facturation et contribuer au suivi financier et administratif des opérations.Veiller à ce que l’ensemble des projets intègre les critères de durabilité de l’entreprise et respecte ses engagements en matière d’impact environnemental, social et économique.

 

Votre profil :

Formation supérieure d’architecte EPF/HES ou d’ingénieur civil EPF/HES avec une solide compréhension des enjeux techniques des projets immobiliers.

Expérience d’au moins 5 ans dans le développement et la réalisation de projets immobiliers. Une expérience dans un rôle d’'AMO est un plus.

Bonne connaissance du cadre réglementaire, urbanistique et administratif applicable aux projets immobiliers en Suisse. Une connaissance de la réglementation relative aux marchés publics est un plus.

Bonne maîtrise des outils numériques ; une connaissance de l’environnement BIM constitue un atout.

Rigueur, autonomie et excellente gestion des priorités.Aisance relationnelle et capacité à coordonner efficacement les différents intervenants.

 

Nous offrons :

5 semaines de vacances et fermeture annuelle entre Noël et Nouvel An.Prestations

LPP avantageuses : cotisation dès le 1er franc sans déduction de coordination.

Soutien actif à la formation continue.

 

Si vous pensez correspondre au profil recherché, adressez\-nous votre dossier de candidature complet via la plateforme jobup.

Als Fachspezialist/in wirst du zusätzlich in unsere Pikettorganisation eingebunden (ca. eine Woche im 12\-Wochen\-Turnus).  **Deine Aufgaben**\- Analyse und Behebung von Störungen auf Kundenanlagen, hauptsächlich via Fernwartung.\- Durchführung von Updates, Parametrierungen und Funktionskontrollen der Software sowie der angeschlossenen Peripheriegeräte.\- Kompetente Beratung der Endkunden bei technischen Anfragen \- per Telefon, E\-Mail und im Ticketsystem.\- Proaktive, professionelle Kundenkommunikation und lösungsorientierte Bearbeitung der offenen Tickets unter Einhaltung der vereinbarten SLAs.\- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Helpdesk, Technical Consultants, Engineering\-Schnittstellen sowie Field\-, Hardware\- und Software\-Technikern.\- Koordination mit der Kunden\-IT, Fachpartnern und weiteren Fachspezialisten bei komplexeren Problemstellungen.\- Unterstützung von Software\- und Hardware\-Technikern sowie Partnern bei der Störungsbehebung.\- Anpassung und Erstellung der Anlagendokumentation sowie Sicherstellung einer aktuellen Dokumentation der Kundensysteme.\- Vollständige und nachvollziehbare Rapportierung aller ausgeführten Arbeiten und Aufwände im Ticketsystem.  **Dein Profil**\- Abgeschlossene Grundbildung als Informatiker/in EFZ oder eine Weiterbildung bzw. Ausbildung auf Stufe HF/FH.\- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im IT\-Software\-Support oder in der Zutrittstechnik, idealerweise mindestens 3 Jahre.\- Erfahrung im Windows\- und Netzwerkumfeld sowie mit SQL\-Datenbanken, idealerweise 2\-4 Jahre.\- Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Analyse und Behebung technischer Störungen auf Kundenanlagen.\- Erfahrung in der Fernwartung und im technischen Support von Software\- und Hardwaresystemen.\- Ausgeprägte Kunden\- und Serviceorientierung sowie Freude an der direkten Kommunikation mit Kunden und Partnern.\- Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein.\- Gute Kommunikations\- und Koordinationsfähigkeiten im Umgang mit internen und externen Schnittstellen.\- Gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse; Italienischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.\- Bereitschaft zur Übernahme des Pikettdienstes (ca. eine Woche im 12\-Wochen\-Turnus).\- Offenheit für die Übernahme neuer Aufgaben im Zuge der Portfoliowerweiterung.  **Was wir bieten**\- Beste Perspektiven in einem international erfolgreichen Unternehmen mit familiärer Unternehmenskultur.\- Ein motiviertes und kompetentes Team, das sich auf deine Unterstützung freut.\- Spannende und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben im technischen Support und im Umfeld moderner Zutrittslösungen.\- Hohe Eigenverantwortung bei der Analyse und Lösung anspruchsvoller technischer Problemstellungen.\- Ein vielseitiges Aufgabengebiet mit enger Zusammenarbeit zu Helpdesk, Engineering, Field Service und weiteren Fachspezialisten\- Transparente Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten.  **Wer wir sind**For every place that matters. Mit über 160 Jahren Erfahrung und einem klaren Fokus auf Exzellenz und Innovation bieten wir spannende Möglichkeiten zur Weiterentwicklung in einem Umfeld, in dem du wirklich etwas bewirken kannst. title: Development Specialist - Sorbent Structures (80-100%)
description: Get to know ClimeworksClimeworks is a leading high-quality carbon removal provider, combining decades of expertise in Direct Air Capture (DAC) technology with a holistic approach to carbon removal solutions.Climeworks advises companies on their carbon removal strategies and provides tailored portfolios of nature-based and engineered approaches, offering end-to-end services to help achieve net-zero goals. The company runs the world's first two DAC plants in Iceland, demonstrating its core commitment to high-quality carbon removal that is backed by over 15 years of pioneering research, development, and deployment.By advancing the most reliable solutions in the market, Climeworks accelerates the global transition to net zero, unlocking economic value for businesses, governments, and society.We foster a dynamic environment and are building a global purpose driven team. We are looking for disruptive thinkers, passionate achievers and inspiring leaders that are ready to take on the world’s greatest challenge.Will you join us?Your missionJob descriptionDevelopment Project OwnershipProject leadership: You define, lead, and interpret test campaigns and modelling activities to advance sorbent structure development and optimisation.Technical ownership: You act as the technical owner for selected development projects, translating strategic goals into structured plans and work packages.External partnerships: You collaborate with technology partners, research institutions, and suppliers to accelerate innovation and development.Cross-functional collaboration: You work closely with sorbent, manufacturing, characterisation, and industrialisation teams to support technology maturation and informed decision-making.Method development: You develop and apply analytical methods, characterisation techniques, and modelling tools to enhance development efficiency and performance. Operational and Laboratory ResponsibilitiesSorbent structures: You prepare, fabricate, and characterise new and existing sorbent structures to support development and testing campaigns from laboratory to pilot scale.Technical insights: You execute experimental work, analyse data, and communicate findings through clear documentation, technical reports, and presentations.Traceability: You maintain organised and reliable records of sorbent structure samples, test articles, and associated datasets to ensure full traceability.Scientific rigour: You reproduce, document, and validate experimental results in accordance with scientific best practices and established quality standards.Lab operations: You contribute to laboratory management through equipment maintenance, operational support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement activities.Testing support: You actively support testing campaigns and characterisation activities to ensure timely delivery of project objectives.Safety: You follow and actively promote safe laboratory and workshop practices, fostering a strong culture of safety and compliance.Your storyRequirementsAcademic background: You hold an advanced degree in materials science, engineering, or a related field.R&D experience: You bring 2–5 years of experience in research and development.Technical expertise: You are skilled in immobilizing sorbents or catalysts in 3D structures and understand how their properties influence system performance.Stakeholder management: You demonstrate excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.Hands-on mentality: You take initiative, are results-driven, and work hands-on from laboratory activities to high-level evaluations.Language skills: You are fluent in English. Nice to have:Industry experience: You bring experience from the catalysis, air filtration, or functional textiles industries.Process expertise: You have experience with gas separation processes.Characterization skills: You are experienced in material and structural characterization techniques.Our promise: At Climeworks, you are accepted for who you are, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply – regardless of background, identity, or experience. Studies show that women and individuals from minority backgrounds often only apply for jobs when they meet 100% of the listed criteria. If this sounds like you, don’t hold back. If you think you’d make a great fit for this role, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t check every single box. Let’s tackle one of humankind’s greatest challenges together.What we offer:Time Off: Enjoy 25 paid vacation days every year, plus public holidays.Flexibility: Work how it suits you best. We offer a hybrid work setup and up to 4 weeks of remote work annually within any EU country.Ownership: Fair base pay paired with an equity package – because your contributions matter.Family Support: Inclusive parental leave.Continuous Learning: Dedicated budget to invest in your professional growth.Referral Rewards: Help us grow our team and earn bonuses for your successful referrals.Salary: At Climeworks, salary ranges are assigned to a job based on the level of seniority and the location specific market median of similar jobs according to external benchmark surveys. Apprenti agriculteur (h/f)
==========================

Etablissement employant quelque 450 collaborateurs afin d'assurer la scolarité spécialisée de 19 enfants et adolescents ainsi que l'accompagnement socioéducatif et socioprofessionnel de 120 adultes présentant une déficience intellectuelle cherche :

 

**Un apprenti agriculteur (h/f)**

 

Au sein de la ferme de l'Association de la Branche, nous cultivons des légumes de plein champ, culture du blé et sarrasin, ainsi que des prairies temporaires. Le reste du domaine est un pâturage permanent, en verger hautes tiges, en prairies extensives et en haies pour les vaches, chevaux, brebis, chèvres.

Le tout géré en agriculture biodynamique. L'équipe se compose d'intervenant socio agricoles, de stagiaires et civilistes, qui accompagnent des personnes présentant une déficience intellectuelle tout en gérant la production de la ferme.

 

**Mission :**

 

* En équipe, participer aux différentes activités de la ferme avec les bénéficiaires (personnes en situation de handicap).
* Participation aux différents colloques organisationnels hebdomadaires.


 

**Nous souhaitons** :

* Intérêt pour l'agriculture biologique et les principes biodynamiques
* Personne curieuse, motivée, autonome et possédant une bonne capacité d'assimilation
* Facilité pour exprimer ses opinions et interagir avec son référent
* Goût du travail en équipe, bon relationnel et grande autonomie
* Une flexibilité d'adaptation pour le planning
* Avoir de la patience et de l'empathie
* Permis de conduire
* Engagement de deux ans


 

**Nous offrons** :

 

* Un suivi régulier tout au long de l'apprentissage
* Une chambre avec cuisinette à gérer de manière autonome
* Les avantages sociaux d'un grand établissement : parking gratuit, cafétéria, piscine et magasin bio. Un site naturel de près de 30 hectares constituant un magnifique cadre de travail

Weiterbildungen unseres Fahrpersonals* Du arbeitest in der betriebsübergreifenden Qualitätssicherung mit* Du lebst eine Vorbildfunktion und übernimmst Weiterbildungsprojekte **Deine Hauptaufgaben** * Qualitätskultur bei TRAVECO aktiv mit* Selbstständigkeit: Du arbeitest als Fachverantwortung mit viel Eigeninitiative* Weiterbildung: Du entwickelst deine Kompetenzen in Didaktik und Konzeption laufend weiter* Sinnhaftigkeit: Die Transportlogistik gehört zu den systemrelevanten Fundamenten unserer Gesellschaft* Flexibilität: Remote\-Office und flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung sind in dieser Funktion möglich **Auf dieses Profil freuen wir uns*** Berufserfahrung in der Transportbranche* Erfahrung im Unterrichten (SVEB 1 oder ähnliche Qualifikation)* Du kennst dich aus im Bereich CZV\-Kurse* Hohe Sozialkompetenz und Freude am Umgang mit Menschen* Erfahrung im Führen von kleinen Teams* Lernbereitschaft und Offenheit für neue Vorschriften, Technik und interne Standards* Gute PC\-Kenntnisse (Microsoft Office 365\)* Selbstständige Arbeitsweise, gute Planung und saubere Nachführung von Unterlagen* Stilsicheres Deutsch und du sprichst ösisch (von Vorteil)TRAVECO Transporte AG60\-80% **Position**  Fach\- / Führungsverantwortung   **Anstellungsart**  unbefristet   **Berufsfeld**  Transport **Fragen zum Bewerbungsprozess**  HR Business Partner   **Fragen zur Stelle**  Bereichsleiter Aus\- \& Weiterbildung   **Entdecke deine Vorteile** **Aus\- und Weiterbildung**  Wir investieren in die Entwicklung unserer Mitarbeitenden. Ein breites internes Bildungsangebot steht allen offen, und wir unterstützen externe Weiterbildungen.   **Attraktive Ferienregelung**  Unsere Ferienregelung garantiert allen Mitarbeitenden mindestens 5 Wochen Ferien. Ab dem 50\. Lebensjahr sind es 6 Wochen und ab dem 60\. Lebensjahr sogar 7 Wochen. Zudem ist der Kauf von weiteren Ferientagen möglich.   **Familienzeit**  Mütter erhalten während der 18 Wochen Mutterschaftsurlaub 100 Prozent ihres versicherten Lohns. Der andere Elternteil geniesst 3 Wochen Familienzeit bei vollem Lohn.   **Versicherungsleistungen**  Wir sichern unsere Mitarbeitenden mit überdurchschnittlichen Sozial\- und Vorsorgeleistungen ab und bieten Sonderkonditionen auf Zusatzversicherungen bei diversen Krankenkassen für ihre gesamte Familie.   **Vergünstigungen und Rabatte**  Unsere Mitarbeitenden profitieren unter anderem von Rabatten beim Einkaufen und Tanken, von Gutschriften auf REKA\-Geld sowie vergünstigten Mobile\-Abos für sie und ihre Familien.     **Unser Bewerbungsprozess**Die Bewerbung läuft ganz einfach über das Online\-Formular – eine Eingangsbestätigung folgt automatisch.Nach sorgfältiger Durchsicht aller Unterlagen gibt's eine Rückmeldung, sobald die Vorauswahl steht.Gratulation! Das Dossier hat überzeugt und wir lernen uns bei ein oder zwei Gesprächen persönlich kennen.Passt es für beide Seiten, folgt ein verbindliches Angebot.Danach heisst es: Willkommen im Team und auf eine gute gemeinsame Zeit! **Über uns**TRAVECO ist ein Logistikunternehmen mit umfassender Kompetenz in Transport\- und Lagerlogistik. Wir sorgen für qualitative, sichere und effiziente Warenflüsse – durch engagierte Mitarbeitende, moderne Infrastruktur und klare Prozesse. Als Arbeitgeberin setzen wir auf Zuverlässigkeit, Nachhaltigkeit und persönliche Entwicklung. Wir sind Teil der Schweizer Agrargenossenschaft fenaco. Zu dieser gehören auch andere namhafte Marken wie UFA, RAMSEIER, Volg, LANDI und AGROLA.
