description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: T24 / Temenos Transact Developer H/F--- T24 / Temenos Transact Developer H/F====================================Membre du groupe Sigmalis, actif depuis 2007 dans le conseil et l’ingénierie en informatique, Sigmalis Talent Services accompagne les entreprises dans l’identification et l’attraction d'experts IT et de cadres, en proposant une offre complète en recrutement: placement fixe, délégation en régie, mission temporaire et executive search.Notre expertise en recrutement depuis plus de 20 ans en Suisse Romande, associée à une compréhension approfondie des métiers technologiques et des enjeux RH, nous permet de vous proposer des opportunités pertinentes dans des environnements professionnels réellement adaptés à vos attentes. Notre priorité est d’assurer votre réussite sur le long terme, que vous soyez en recherche d’un poste fixe chez un client ou comme consultant au sein de notre équipe.### Description du posteWe are looking for an experienced **T24 / Temenos Transact Developer** to join the Sigmalis consulting team.You will be involved in the development, maintenance and support of solutions based on **Temenos T24 / Transact**. You will participate in the full software development lifecycle and work closely with Business Analysts and Product Owners to translate functional requirements into suitable technical solutions.### Your responsibilitiesYou will be responsible for:* collaborating with Business Analysts and Product Owners to translate requirements into technical designs and solutions,* developing new features and maintaining or improving existing code using an Agile approach,* carrying out the necessary testing, analysing results and debugging when required,* customising T24 modules to meet client requirements while following best practices,* documenting new solutions and changes in source code, Confluence and JIRA,* communicating regularly on development progress and any issues or blockers,* supporting the teams during Unit Testing, SIT and UAT phases,* contributing to the preparation of production rollouts,* analysing and resolving incidents as part of day\-to\-day support.### Profil recherchéYou have:* at least **5 years of experience with Temenos T24 / Transact**,* excellent knowledge of **Temenos Design Studio, IRIS Services, TAFJ, Oracle Database and Linux**,* strong software development skills and experience in optimising the performance of existing code,* experience in troubleshooting and resolving support issues,* knowledge of processes and modules related to **Securities STP, Corporate Actions and Treasury**, including Fiduciary, Money Market, Forex, AA and TPH,* experience with **DevOps methodologies and tools**, including Bitbucket, Jenkins and Design Studio,* strong problem\-solving and debugging skills,* a good understanding of the software development lifecycle,* a rigorous, analytical and quality\-focused approach.An **excellent command of English**, both in professional and technical environments, is essential.Experience with **Agile methodologies** and knowledge of the **Wealth Management industry** would be considered an advantage.### What the Sigmalis Group offers* A particularly advantageous pension plan (LPP),* An annual variable bonus linked to individual performance and company results,* The possibility to work remotely and take unpaid leave, subject to client approval,* Mission\-specific benefits such as public transport subscriptions, training and other advantages.If you recognise yourself in this profile, we would be pleased to receive your application, which should include **your CV and your complete application file, including copies of diplomas, employment certificates and other relevant documents**.![SIGMALIS Sàrl]()* SIGMALIS Sàrl  Route de Meyrin 123  1219 Châtelaine*jid03ef69cjm jit1148jm jiy26jm

Unsere Kunden sind KMU aus allen Branchen, Privatkunden, öffentlich\-rechtliche sowie börsenkotierte Unternehmen. title: Technicien de maintenance électromécanique
description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Technicien de maintenance électromécanique --- Technicien de maintenance électromécanique ============================================ \*\*Rejoignez un acteur clé de la micro\\-fabrication médicale\*\* --------------------------------------------------------------- Chez Resonetics, nous repoussons les limites de la micro\\-fabrication au service des dispositifs médicaux et du diagnostic. Nos technologies de pointe permettent à nos clients d'innover et d'améliorer la vie des patients à travers le monde. Notre site de Puidoux, qui compte 150 collaborateurs, est un fournisseur stratégique de tubes métalliques et composants de haute précision destinés aux appareils médicaux. Dans un contexte de croissance et d'exigence réglementaire forte, nous renforçons notre équipe qualité. Nous recherchons un \*\*technicien de maintenance électromécanique\*\* prêt à jouer un rôle clé dans la fiabilité et la performance de nos équipements, tout en assurant leur bon fonctionnement et en accompagnant nos équipes de production au quotidien. \*\*Mission\*\* ----------- Au sein de l'équipe de la Maintenance, vous assurez la maintenance préventive et corrective des équipements de production afin de garantir leur disponibilité, leur fiabilité et leur performance. Vous participez à l'ensemble des activités du service maintenance tout en apportant une expertise particulière en électricité industrielle et en diagnostic de pannes. \*\*Vos principales responsabilités\*\* ------------------------------------ \* Réaliser les opérations de maintenance préventive et corrective sur les équipements de production. \* Diagnostiquer et dépanner les pannes électriques, mécaniques, pneumatiques et électromécaniques. \* Assurer la remise en service des équipements dans le respect des exigences sécurité, qualité et production. \* Participer à la mise à jour de la documentation technique et des schémas électriques. \* Identifier les composants défectueux ou obsolètes et rechercher des solutions de remplacement adaptées. \* Collaborer avec les fournisseurs et accompagner les prestataires externes lors de leurs interventions. \* Participer aux actions d'amélioration continue visant à améliorer la fiabilité des équipements et à réduire les temps d'arrêt. \* Assurer la traçabilité des interventions dans la GMAO. \*\*Votre profil\*\* ---------------- \* CFC d'Automaticien ou formation technique équivalente avec expérience en maintenance industrielle. \* Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en maintenance industrielle, idéalement dans un environnement réglementé (ISO 13485 ou équivalent). \* Expérience du dépannage et de la maintenance sur des équipements industriels variés, y compris des équipements anciens. \* Maîtrise du français à l'oral et à l'écrit. \* Solides connaissances en électricité industrielle et bonnes connaissances en mécanique industrielle et pneumatique. \* Connaissance d'une GMAO. \* Maîtrise de la lecture de schémas électriques et du diagnostic de pannes. \* Connaissances en automates industriels et interfaces opérateur constituant un atout. \* Autorisation OIBT art. 13 ou 15 constituant un atout. \* Personne autonome et pragmatique, dotée d'un fort esprit de terrain et d'une approche orientée vers la recherche de solutions concrètes. \*\*Ce que nous vous offrons\*\* ---------------------------- \* Un environnement industriel de haute précision, technologiquement exigeant et stimulant. \* Une forte proximité avec la production, l'ingénierie et les clients. \* Une équipe engagée et collaborative. \* Des projets variés et des interactions avec des clients et équipes internationales. \* L'opportunité de contribuer concrètement à l'amélioration et à la transformation de nos processus qualité. \* Des possibilités de développement professionnel au sein d'un groupe international en croissance. Chez Resonetics, nous valorisons l'excellence, l'engagement et l'esprit d'équipe. Si vous souhaitez contribuer à des projets innovants dans un environnement dynamique, nous serions ravis d'échanger avec vous. \*Le masculin est utilisé pour alléger le texte et inclut le féminin.\* !\[Resonetics SA\]( ) \* Resonetics SA Route de Chardonne 4 1070 Puidoux \* \[ \](\< \>) jpid2f88817jm jpit1148jm jpiy26jm

title: Responsable Conformité
description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Responsable Conformité (100%) --- Responsable Conformité (100%) ============================== L'Office cantonal des assurances sociales est une institution autonome de droit public et constitue un pôle de compétences dans les assurances sociales du 1er pilier. Il gère et coordonne quatre régimes d'assurance : assurance\\-vieillesse et survivants, assurance\\-invalidité, allocations familiales et allocations pour perte de gain. Pour relever les défis actuels, l'OCAS est à la recherche d'un\\-e \*\*Responsable conformité\*\* (100 %) Classe de fonction 23 Au sein du domaine des services partagés et rattaché\\-e au responsable adjoint du domaine, vous avez pour mission de construire et piloter le nouveau secteur conformité de l'OCAS. Vous donnez à l'institution une vue unique de sa maîtrise en matière de gestion des risques, de contrôle interne, de qualité, de sécurité de l'information et de protection des données. Pour ce faire, vous réunissez et développez les dispositifs existants que la loi impose aux organes d'exécution du 1er pilier. Dans un contexte réglementaire exigeant et en évolution, vous priorisez selon les risques que l'institution doit maîtriser. Dans une logique de deuxième ligne de maîtrise, vous élaborez et déployez progressivement le cadre méthodologique, accompagnez la mise en œuvre par les secteurs et les domaines, qui restent responsables de leurs risques, et contrôlez l'efficacité du dispositif. The EPFL campus offers an exceptional working environment at the heart of a community of more than 17,000 people, including over 12,500 students and 4,000 researchers from more than 120 different countries. Research Ethics Compliance Officer Sensitive Data \*\*Mission\*\* The EPFL Research Office (ReO) is seeking a Research Ethics Compliance Officer to support EPFL's research community with ethics compliance and governance aspects of research projects that are within the scope of the Swiss Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings and the Federal Data Protection Act. This position will also support the establishment and implementation of (i) EPFL's Trusted Research Environment (TRE) "" an ISO 27001\\-certified infrastructure for the processing of sensitive data, with a focus on health\\-related data "" and (ii) the institutional biobank. The candidate is an individual with proven competence in ethics compliance related to scientific research (incl. with health\\-related data and human samples). She/he will have excellent communication skills and the ability to work in a dynamic team. \*\*Main duties and responsibilities\*\* Support EPFL principal investigators and ReO Programme Managers in ensuring ethics and regulatory compliance \* Advise researchers on the applicable ethics and regulatory framework for research involving human participants, human biological samples, and personal/sensitive data. \* Assess the applicability of the Swiss Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings (HRA) and its Ordinances, the Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP), and other Swiss or international requirements, in collaboration with Legal Affairs. \* Guide researchers through appropriate ethics approval procedures and support applications to Cantonal ethics committees. \* Review submissions for quality and completeness and support amendments, renewals and project closures. \* Act as point of contact between researchers and Cantonal ethics committees or other relevant authorities (FOPH, FOEN, etc.) and support follow\\-up on their requirements. Develop guidance documents, resources, training and awareness\\-raising initiatives \* Contribute to institutional procedures and SOPs for research involving human participants, human biological samples, and personal and sensitive data, particularly health\\-related data. \* Develop practical guidance and resources and promote good practices in human research through training and awareness\\-raising activities. Provide support on specific ethics compliance and regulatory questions \* Provide tailored advice on ethics and regulatory questions throughout the lifecycle of projects within the scope of the HRA, FADP. \* Advise on regulatory aspects of human biological sample transfers and redirect researchers to Legal Affairs and TTO for relevant agreements. \* Coordinate with Legal Affairs, TTO, DPO, Library, IT services, Biosafety officers and DSPS on cross\\-cutting regulatory matters. \* Contribute to institutional ethics compliance procedures and positions on emerging regulatory questions, in collaboration with relevant services. Provide ethics compliance input and support for the development and implementation of EPFL's institutional framework for the management of sensitive research data (focus: health\\-related data) and biological samples \* Contribute to the roadmap for EPFL's sensitive/human research data framework, in collaboration with the Institutional Coordinator Human Research Infrastructure and relevant institutional units (Legal Affairs, DPO, IT, etc.). \* Develop internal governance frameworks, workflows/SOPs, tools and guidance for the ethics/legal compliance of projects involving sensitive research data and/or biological samples. \* Ensure ethics compliance and governance requirements for EPFL's biobank infrastructure, including governance regulations, consent documentation and procedures, and certification processes ( SBP Label or ISO). \* Obtain ethics authorization for the EPFL biobank infrastructure, including preparation and submission of the application and interactions with the Cantonal Ethics Committee. Support the activities of the EPFL Human Research Ethics Committee (HREC) \* Provide regulatory and administrative support for the review and follow\\-up of research protocols involving humans that fall outside the HRA but require HREC approval. Support other tasks within the ReO/Ethics Affairs \* Maintain an institutional overview of HRA protocols where EPFL acts as sponsor, partner or participant, including authorizations, amendments, renewals and closures. \* Collaborate with relevant internal services on cross\\-cutting ethics compliance and regulatory matters. \* Support other Ethics Affairs activities as required. \*\*Profile\*\* \* Master's degree in a relevant field, such as law (specialization human research), public health, life sciences, biomedical sciences or related field (additional certifications and licenses in relation to ethics compliance, biobanking and data protection will be considered a strong asset). \* Solid knowledge and expertise about the ethics compliance framework and of the ethics compliance and governance requirements in Switzerland (Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings and the Federal Data Protection Act (FADP) and their application). \* Knowledge about management of human biological samples, human subjects/clinical research data, clinical trials, and biobanks. \* Extensive experience with the preparation and submission of ethics applications to the Cantonal Ethics Committees. \* Ability to analyse and understand research projects in relation to the Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings and the FADP. \* Ability to explain the ethics compliance regulations on research involving humans, personal/sensitive data, biological samples, etc. to researchers who are not necessarily familiar with this area of work. \* Experience in preparing and developing ethics compliance related guidance documents and tools/resources for a broad audience. \* Excellent collaboration skills to conduct joint projects and to liaise with internal and external stakeholders (such as legal affairs, cantonal ethics commissions, etc.). \* Good organization skills, and the ability to set priorities and meet deadlines. \* The ability to work both independently and in a team, and to adapt to the individual needs of EPFL principal investigators. \* Excellent collaboration skills to conduct joint projects and to liaise with internal and external stakeholders (such as legal affairs, DPO, IT, Cantonal ethics commissions, etc.). \* Strong writing, editing and proofreading skills in English. \*\*We offer\*\* \* A dynamic and cosmopolitan work environment in a multidisciplinary institution. \* Competitive salary, remote working may be possible for a portion of the time. \* The opportunity of continuous training and development according to the requirements of the function. At EPFL, we believe that people achieve great results when they feel supported, respected and enabled to succeed. By joining our community, you will help shape the future of society through education, research and innovation. We offer an inspiring, international and collaborative environment where your work has real impact and your ideas are valued. Combined with flexible ways of working and attractive employment conditions, we aim to create an environment where everyone can contribute, grow and make a difference. description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Marketing &amp; Commercial Manager (100%) Anglais – çais---Marketing \& Commercial Manager (100%) Anglais – çais========================================================Fondée le 14 avril 1900 à , l’Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI) est l’instance faîtière du cyclisme dans le monde. Sa mission consiste à développer et superviser le cyclisme sous toutes ses formes et pour tout le monde, en tant que sport de compétition, activité de loisir saine, et moyen de transport et de s’amuser. L’UCI assure par ailleurs la promotion de ses propres événements, notamment des Championnats du Monde Route UCI, manifestation annuelle emblématique, et d’un grand nombre d’autres Championnats du Monde et Coupes du Monde dans les différentes disciplines. Son siège se trouve à Aigle, en Suisse, au Centre Mondial du Cyclisme UCI. L’UCI est à la recherche d’un(e) : Marketing \& Commercial Manager (100%) Anglais – çais======================================================== **Mission:**Sous la supervision du Directeur Communication, Marketing, Médias et RSE, le/la Marketing \& Commercial Manager dirige la division Marketing and Commercial, qui réunit les partenariats, le servicing partenaires et le développement commercial de l’UCI. Il/elle est responsable de la conception, du suivi de la commercialisation et du pilotage des agences commerciales, de la livraison des packages marketing et sponsoring, , ainsi que de la stratégie merchandising et licensing de l’organisation.Il/elle joue un rôle clé dans la livraison des Championnats du Monde UCI et garantit la livraison optimale des engagements partenaires sur l’ensemble de nos Championnats du Monde. Il/elle développe et contribue à l’innovation digitale et au fan engagement, et entretient une relation de confiance avec les partenaires tout au long de l’année.  **Principales responsabilités**:* Manager la division Marketing and Commercial et encadrer son équipe (coordinateurs partenariats marketing et assistant commercial) : priorités, plan de charge et suivi des objectifs.  * Piloter les agences commerciales mandatées par l’UCI : objectifs, suivi des prospects, des négociations et du reporting.  * Superviser l’activité commerciale de l’UCI et du Centre Mondial du Cyclisme UCI.  * Concevoir, mettre à jour et commercialiser les packages marketing et sponsoring (droits marketing, hospitalités, activations, digital).  * Mener les négociations de nouveaux contrats et les renégociations des contrats existants.  * Identifier des opportunités innovantes de revenus et proposer de nouveaux concepts marketing.  * Être l’interlocuteur(trice) principal(e) des partenaires : coordination, réunions, communication et événements corporate.  * Superviser la livraison de toutes les contreparties marketing et activations sur les événements, en lien avec l’équipe Digital pour les activations digitales.  * Développer des initiatives dépassant le cadre contractuel pour renforcer la valeur partenariale et fidéliser les partenaires.  * Définir et valider la répartition des droits marketing pour chaque événement, assurer le suivi des contrats LOC, valider les partenaires locaux et organiser des visites de sites avec sponsors et LOC.  * Déployer et superviser la stratégie merchandising et licensing de la marque UCI « Rainbow » : gammes de produits, partenaires de production et de distribution, conformité de l’utilisation de la marque.  * Préparer, analyser et suivre le budget de la division ainsi que les revenus marketing et commerciaux.  * Toute autre mission liée au service marketing et commercial, selon les besoins du service.    **Profil:*** Formation supérieure en marketing, commerce, management du sport ou commerce international, idéalement avec une spécialisation en marketing sportif ou sponsoring, ou expérience équivalente.  * 7 à 10 ans d’expérience en marketing, partenariats, sponsoring ou vente de droits, de préférence dans le sport international ou l’événementiel.  * Expérience confirmée de la vente et de la négociation de partenariats, avec des résultats commerciaux démontrables.  * Expérience du pilotage d’agences commerciales ou de prestataires externes.  * Expérience confirmée en management d’équipe et en coordination de projets internationaux.  * Expérience de la livraison de contreparties partenaires et d’activations sur des événements sportifs majeurs.  * Connaissance du merchandising et du licensing.  * Capacité à développer et entretenir des relations solides avec les partenaires et les comités d’organisation locaux.  * Esprit créatif pour proposer des concepts marketing innovants et des activations digitales.  * Rigueur, sens de l’organisation et capacité à gérer les pics d’activité liés aux événements.  * Parfaite maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, écrit et oral.  * Intérêt pour le sport, idéalement le cyclisme.  * Disponible pour voyager et travailler ponctuellement les week\-ends.    **Entrée en fonction:** de suite ou à convenir Nous rejoindre, c’est avoir l’opportunité d’exploiter transformation initiatives that create measurable business value.**Your profile**:* University degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration or a related field.* Minimum application landscapes.* Strong understanding of cyber security, infrastructure, applications, data and emerging technologies, with sufficient technical depth to challenge and guide specialist teams and technology decisions.* Experience operating in publicly listed and regulated environments, including SOX and related internal control frameworks.* Strong commercial mindset with experience managing strategic technology vendors and outsourcing partners.* Strategic yet pragmatic leader with excellent stakeholder management skills and a proven ability to translate business priorities into title: Development Specialist - Sorbent Structures (80-100%)
description: Get to know ClimeworksClimeworks is a leading high-quality carbon removal provider, combining decades of expertise in Direct Air Capture (DAC) technology with a holistic approach to carbon removal solutions.Climeworks advises companies on their carbon removal strategies and provides tailored portfolios of nature-based and engineered approaches, offering end-to-end services to help achieve net-zero goals. The company runs the world's first two DAC plants in Iceland, demonstrating its core commitment to high-quality carbon removal that is backed by over 15 years of pioneering research, development, and deployment.By advancing the most reliable solutions in the market, Climeworks accelerates the global transition to net zero, unlocking economic value for businesses, governments, and society.We foster a dynamic environment and are building a global purpose driven team. We are looking for disruptive thinkers, passionate achievers and inspiring leaders that are ready to take on the world’s greatest challenge.Will you join us?Your missionJob descriptionDevelopment Project OwnershipProject leadership: You define, lead, and interpret test campaigns and modelling activities to advance sorbent structure development and optimisation.Technical ownership: You act as the technical owner for selected development projects, translating strategic goals into structured plans and work packages.External partnerships: You collaborate with technology partners, research institutions, and suppliers to accelerate innovation and development.Cross-functional collaboration: You work closely with sorbent, manufacturing, characterisation, and industrialisation teams to support technology maturation and informed decision-making.Method development: You develop and apply analytical methods, characterisation techniques, and modelling tools to enhance development efficiency and performance. Operational and Laboratory ResponsibilitiesSorbent structures: You prepare, fabricate, and characterise new and existing sorbent structures to support development and testing campaigns from laboratory to pilot scale.Technical insights: You execute experimental work, analyse data, and communicate findings through clear documentation, technical reports, and presentations.Traceability: You maintain organised and reliable records of sorbent structure samples, test articles, and associated datasets to ensure full traceability.Scientific rigour: You reproduce, document, and validate experimental results in accordance with scientific best practices and established quality standards.Lab operations: You contribute to laboratory management through equipment maintenance, operational support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement activities.Testing support: You actively support testing campaigns and characterisation activities to ensure timely delivery of project objectives.Safety: You follow and actively promote safe laboratory and workshop practices, fostering a strong culture of safety and compliance.Your storyRequirementsAcademic background: You hold an advanced degree in materials science, engineering, or a related field.R&D experience: You bring 2–5 years of experience in research and development.Technical expertise: You are skilled in immobilizing sorbents or catalysts in 3D structures and understand how their properties influence system performance.Stakeholder management: You demonstrate excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.Hands-on mentality: You take initiative, are results-driven, and work hands-on from laboratory activities to high-level evaluations.Language skills: You are fluent in English. Nice to have:Industry experience: You bring experience from the catalysis, air filtration, or functional textiles industries.Process expertise: You have experience with gas separation processes.Characterization skills: You are experienced in material and structural characterization techniques.Our promise: At Climeworks, you are accepted for who you are, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply – regardless of background, identity, or experience. Studies show that women and individuals from minority backgrounds often only apply for jobs when they meet 100% of the listed criteria. If this sounds like you, don’t hold back. If you think you’d make a great fit for this role, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t check every single box. Let’s tackle one of humankind’s greatest challenges together.What we offer:Time Off: Enjoy 25 paid vacation days every year, plus public holidays.Flexibility: Work how it suits you best. We offer a hybrid work setup and up to 4 weeks of remote work annually within any EU country.Ownership: Fair base pay paired with an equity package – because your contributions matter.Family Support: Inclusive parental leave.Continuous Learning: Dedicated budget to invest in your professional growth.Referral Rewards: Help us grow our team and earn bonuses for your successful referrals.Salary: At Climeworks, salary ranges are assigned to a job based on the level of seniority and the location specific market median of similar jobs according to external benchmark surveys. Individual compensation depends on your skills, experience, and the value you bring to the team.Formalities: This position is based in Opfikon, Zurich, and we ask that you work onsite at least three days per week.The percentage in the job title means flexibility – choose full-time or part-time based on what works for you.We do not accept candidate profiles through recruitment agencies.

title: AI Architect 100%
description: # AI Architect**Location** · Zurich, Switzerland## About the RoleWe’re looking for an AI Architect to lead the technical strategy for AI across our products and internal systems. You’ll turn business priorities into architecture decisions and guide AI initiatives from use case definition through to production. Your focus will be on building secure, scalable, and cost-effective cloud solutions that teams can operate and maintain.You’ll work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, software architects, product leaders, and executives to set technical direction, explain trade-offs, and guide delivery.## Key Responsibilities### Architecture and strategy- Design end-to-end AI and ML architectures covering data ingestion, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.- Define the enterprise AI roadmap, reference architectures, and technology standards.- Lead build-versus-buy assessments for foundation models, open-source models, and vendor platforms.### Cloud architecture- Design and lead the delivery of cloud-native AI solutions on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud using managed AI services and scalable infrastructure.- Define cloud landing zones, networking, identity and access management, and security patterns for AI workloads.- Develop hybrid or multi-cloud strategies where appropriate, taking data residency into account.- Optimize cloud cost and performance through FinOps practices, including GPU capacity planning and autoscaling.### Generative AI and large language models- Design applications that use large language models (LLMs), including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, tool integration, and fine-tuning.- Define evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and monitoring for model quality, safety, latency, and cost.- Evaluate model and retrieval performance against business use cases and establish standards for managing prompts, context, and models.### ML platforms and MLOps- Lead the design of scalable ML platforms, including feature stores, vector databases, model registries, CI/CD pipelines, and inference infrastructure.- Design production AI systems for reliability, scalability, and disaster recovery.### Governance, security, and responsible AI- Embed security, privacy, and responsible AI principles into solution design. Work with legal and compliance teams to address applicable requirements and assurance standards.- Define standards for bias testing, explainability, auditability, and data governance.- Partner with legal, security, and risk teams to develop and implement AI policies.### Technical leadership and collaboration- Align business stakeholders, engineering teams, vendors, and cloud providers on architecture decisions and delivery priorities.- Mentor ML engineers, data scientists, and software teams.- Explain AI capabilities, risks, and trade-offs to executives and non-technical stakeholders.- Produce and review technical documentation, architecture decision records, and presentations.- Lead architecture reviews, proofs of concept, and vendor evaluations.- Follow developments in AI research, tools, and industry practices to inform technology decisions.## Required Experience and Technical Skills- **8+ years in software or data engineering**, including **4+ years designing and delivering production AI or ML solutions**.- **5+ years of hands-on cloud experience**, with deep expertise in at least one major platform and its AI services, such as AWS SageMaker and Bedrock, Azure AI and Azure OpenAI Service, or Google Cloud Vertex AI.- Proven experience designing cloud-native systems using serverless services, containers, Docker, Kubernetes, networking, identity and access management, and security best practices.- Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep, and with managing cloud costs.- Deep understanding of machine learning, deep learning, large language models, and generative AI techniques.- Hands-on Python experience with tools such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face libraries, and experience with LangChain or LlamaIndex.- Proven MLOps experience, including CI/CD, model monitoring, and workflow orchestration.- Strong knowledge of data architecture, including data lakes and warehouses, streaming, vector databases, and ETL/ELT pipelines.- Experience designing secure, scalable distributed systems and APIs.- Strong communication, stakeholder management, and technical documentation skills.## Preferred Qualifications- Professional cloud certifications in architecture, AI, or machine learning from AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.- Experience designing hybrid or multi-cloud architectures and leading cloud migrations.- Experience building multi-agent systems and agentic AI architectures.- Familiarity with model adaptation and optimization techniques such as LoRA, RLHF, distillation, and quantization, and with inference tools such as vLLM or TensorRT.- Experience in regulated environments such as financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, or government.- Published research, patents, or open-source contributions.## Key Competencies- Systems thinking and sound architectural judgment.- Ability to work effectively across functions and cultures.- Practical judgment when balancing innovation, delivery, cost, and risk.- Ownership and sound decision-making when requirements are still evolving.- Ability to influence decisions without direct authority.- Commitment to ethical and responsible AI.

description: Vizedirektor-Operations (m/w/d) 100% Das Hotel Astoria an bester Lage im Zentrum von Luzern und nur wenige Gehminuten vom Bahnhof, dem KKL, der Altstadt und dem Vierwaldstättersee entfernt, ist ein topmodernes 4-Sterne Hotel mit 263 renovierten Zimmern sowie 5 Bankett- und Seminarräumen mit state-of-the-art Ausstattung. Ihre Hauptaufgaben: Als Vizedirektor - Operations sind Sie direkt dem General Manager unterstellt und arbeiten eng mit ihm zusammen. Sie koordinieren gemeinsam mit unserem Hotel Manager und Director of F&B den gesamten operativen Betrieb des Hotel ASTORIA. Dabei sind Sie nicht einfach eine zusätzliche Hierarchiestufe, sondern die zentrale operative Schnittstelle zwischen allen Abteilungen.  Sie sind dort, wo das Geschehen stattfindet. Sie erkennen, wo es klemmt, setzen Prioritäten und sorgen gemeinsam mit den verantwortlichen Führungskräften dafür, dass das Besprochene lösungsorientiert umgesetzt wird. -       Vertretung des General Managers in allen operativen Belangen -        Sie sind Gastgeber und Macher zugleich -       Koordination des gesamten operativen Tagesgeschäfts über Rooms und F&B -        Sicherstellung der reibungslosen Prozesse aller operativen Bereiche -        Präsenz am Gast und aktive Unterstützung der Führungskräfte -       Erkennen von Schwachstellen und konsequente Verbesserung von Abläufen -        Sicherstellung unserer Qualitäts- und Servicestandards gemäss SOP`s -        Handling und aktive Führung bei anspruchsvollen operativen Situationen -        Förderung einer direkten, unkomplizierten und lösungsorientierten Zusammenarbeit Unsere Anforderungen: Sie verfügen über mehrere Jahre Führungserfahrung in der gehobenen Hotellerie und Sie fühlen sich im Mittelpunkt des Geschehens am wohlsten. Sie bewegen sich in der Rooms Abteilung genauso sicher wie in der Food & Beverage Abteilung.  Sie haben die Persönlichkeit, erfahrene Führungskräfte auf Augenhöhe zu koordinieren, unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenzubringen und Entscheidungen konsequent umzusetzen. Sie sind am Gast präsent, als Mensch belastbar, freundlich aber klar in Ihrer Kommunikation und haben ein gutes Gespür und Freude am Menschen. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind eine Voraussetzung.  Und vor allem: Sie haben Freude am Hotel ASTORIA Luzern! Was wir bieten: Eine aussergewöhnliche Führungsposition in einem der spannendsten Hotel- und Gastronomiebetriebe der Schweiz, an zentraler Lage in Luzern.  Bei uns bekommen Sie keinen Job, bei dem Sie den ganzen Tag hinter einem Schreibtisch sitzen. Sie erhalten Verantwortung, Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, gemeinsam mit einem erfahrenen Führungsteam einen grossen und vielseitigen Betrieb weiterzuentwickeln. Sind Sie neugierig geworden? description: Ref 2592631 \\\| Date: 23 Nov 2026 !\[EPFL\]( ) EPFL, the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne, is one of the most dynamic university campuses in Europe and ranks among the top 20 universities worldwide. The EPFL employs more than 6,500 people supporting the three main missions of the institution: education, research and innovation. The EPFL campus offers an exceptional working environment at the heart of a community of more than 17,000 people, including over 12,500 students and 4,000 researchers from more than 120 different countries. Research Ethics Compliance Officer Sensitive Data \*\*Mission\*\* The EPFL Research Office (ReO) is seeking a Research Ethics Compliance Officer to support EPFL's research community with ethics compliance and governance aspects of research projects that are within the scope of the Swiss Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings and the Federal Data Protection Act. This position will also support the establishment and implementation of (i) EPFL's Trusted Research Environment (TRE) "" an ISO 27001\\-certified infrastructure for the processing of sensitive data, with a focus on health\\-related data "" and (ii) the institutional biobank. The candidate is an individual with proven competence in ethics compliance related to scientific research (incl. with health\\-related data and human samples). She/he will have excellent communication skills and the ability to work in a dynamic team. \*\*Main duties and responsibilities\*\* Support EPFL principal investigators and ReO Programme Managers in ensuring ethics and regulatory compliance \* Advise researchers on the applicable ethics and regulatory framework for research involving human participants, human biological samples, and personal/sensitive data. \* Assess the applicability of the Swiss Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings (HRA) and its Ordinances, the Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP), and other Swiss or international requirements, in collaboration with Legal Affairs. \* Guide researchers through appropriate ethics approval procedures and support applications to Cantonal ethics committees. \* Review submissions for quality and completeness and support amendments, renewals and project closures. \* Act as point of contact between researchers and Cantonal ethics committees or other relevant authorities (FOPH, FOEN, etc.) and support follow\\-up on their requirements. Develop guidance documents, resources, training and awareness\\-raising initiatives \* Contribute to institutional procedures and SOPs for research involving human participants, human biological samples, and personal and sensitive data, particularly health\\-related data. \* Develop practical guidance and resources and promote good practices in human research through training and awareness\\-raising activities. Provide support on specific ethics compliance and regulatory questions \* Provide tailored advice on ethics and regulatory questions throughout the lifecycle of projects within the scope of the HRA, FADP. \* Advise on regulatory aspects of human biological sample transfers and redirect researchers to Legal Affairs and TTO for relevant agreements. \* Coordinate with Legal Affairs, TTO, DPO, Library, IT services, Biosafety officers and DSPS on cross\\-cutting regulatory matters. \* Contribute to institutional ethics compliance procedures and positions on emerging regulatory questions, in collaboration with relevant services. Provide ethics compliance input and support for the development and implementation of EPFL's institutional framework for the management of sensitive research data (focus: health\\-related data) and biological samples \* Contribute to the roadmap for EPFL's sensitive/human research data framework, in collaboration with the Institutional Coordinator Human Research Infrastructure and relevant institutional units (Legal Affairs, DPO, IT, etc.). \* Develop internal governance frameworks, workflows/SOPs, tools and guidance for the ethics/legal compliance of projects involving sensitive research data and/or biological samples. \* Ensure ethics compliance and governance requirements for EPFL's biobank infrastructure, including governance regulations, consent documentation and procedures, and certification processes ( SBP Label or ISO). \* Obtain ethics authorization for the EPFL biobank infrastructure, including preparation and submission of the application and interactions with the Cantonal Ethics Committee. Support the activities of the EPFL Human Research Ethics Committee (HREC) \* Provide regulatory and administrative support for the review and follow\\-up of research protocols involving humans that fall outside the HRA but require HREC approval. Support other tasks within the ReO/Ethics Affairs \* Maintain an institutional overview of HRA protocols where EPFL acts as sponsor, partner or participant, including authorizations, amendments, renewals and closures. \* Collaborate with relevant internal services on cross\\-cutting ethics compliance and regulatory matters. \* Support other Ethics Affairs activities as required. \*\*Profile\*\* \* Master's degree in a relevant field, such as law (specialization human research), public health, life sciences, biomedical sciences or related field (additional certifications and licenses in relation to ethics compliance, biobanking and data protection will be considered a strong asset). \* Solid knowledge and expertise about the ethics compliance framework and of the ethics compliance and governance requirements in Switzerland (Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings and the Federal Data Protection Act (FADP) and their application). \* Knowledge about management of human biological samples, human subjects/clinical research data, clinical trials, and biobanks. \* Extensive experience with the preparation and submission of ethics applications to the Cantonal Ethics Committees. \* Ability to analyse and understand research projects in relation to the Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings and the FADP. \* Ability to explain the ethics compliance regulations on research involving humans, personal/sensitive data, biological samples, etc. to researchers who are not necessarily familiar with this area of work. \* Experience in preparing and developing ethics compliance related guidance documents and tools/resources for a broad audience. \* Excellent collaboration skills to conduct joint projects and to liaise with internal and external stakeholders (such as legal affairs, cantonal ethics commissions, etc.). \* Good organization skills, and the ability to set priorities and meet deadlines. \* The ability to work both independently and in a team, and to adapt to the individual needs of EPFL principal investigators. \* Excellent collaboration skills to conduct joint projects and to liaise with internal and external stakeholders (such as legal affairs, DPO, IT, Cantonal ethics commissions, etc.). \* Strong writing, editing and proofreading skills in English. \*\*We offer\*\* \* A dynamic and cosmopolitan work environment in a multidisciplinary institution. \* Competitive salary, remote working may be possible for a portion of the time. \* The opportunity of continuous training and development according to the requirements skills.## Preferred Qualifications- Professional cloud certifications in architecture, AI, or machine learning from AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.- Experience designing hybrid or multi-cloud HR Business Partner

**The company**

**HR Business Partner (100%)**

**Job description**

In this role, you will manage the complete employee life cycle and support our managers as a coach and consultant, helping them guide their teams toward success. Your mission? Build a great work environment, solve challenges with style, and contribute to the vibrant culture of our company.

**Profile**

**Your responsibilities will include:**

* Support managers in handling discussions, resolving issues, and navigating team conflicts.
* Organise and control of the yearly evaluation and talent management process, and follow\-up with measures if needed.
* Follow up on development needs and action plans.
* Handle warnings and contract terminations.


At Swatch Group Services, we value fresh ideas, especially in areas like employer branding, employee retention \& HR process optimization, to keep improving our quality standards and elevating the employee experience.

**Professional requirements**

* University degree in HR or equivalent (Brevet fédéral) with over 5 years of experience in a similar role.

* Autonomous and self\-motivated, with initiative and an ability to manage multiple priorities with a sense of urgency.
* You are data driven as well as highly organized: You have a very structured way of working, being able to prioritize a variety of complex tasks and to complete them diligently


**You're missing one or two skills in the list, yet you're eager to learn?  
It's perfectly OK. We like to share.**

**Languages**

Now, in order to blend in, socially and professionally, we certainly recommend the following languages:

* Fluent in French and in English, combined with good knowledge of German considered an asset.

* On\-site company restaurant with employer financial contribution
* Exclusive discounts on Swatch Group products and with our partners

description: Postdoc in Computational Systems Biology and Metabolic Modeling Postdoc in Computational Systems Biology and Metabolic Modeling===============================================================Dysregulation of lipid metabolism plays a key role in the development and progression of metabolic disorders, including obesity, type 2 diabetes, and metabolic dysfunction\-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). We are seeking a highly motivated Scientist in Computational and Systems Biology to work on a project funded by the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF) aimed at advancing our understanding of human lipid metabolism in MASLD. The project focuses on modelling human metabolism by integrating clinical data with experimental models. It involves biochemical and molecular data from multiple tissues and biofluids to investigate tissue\-specific metabolism, metabolic interactions across organs, and nutrient uptake, transformation, and release. The project combines statistical modelling, systems biology, and in silico metabolic modelling with clinical, transcriptomic, proteomic, metabolomic/lipidomic, spatial molecular imaging, and experimental metabolic flux data to provide new insights into the complex metabolic alterations underlying MASLD.**What you can expect*** Develop and apply mathematical, statistical, and machine\-learning models to complex, high\-dimensional, and multimodal biological and clinical datasets, including spatial and imaging data* Model lipid and nutrient metabolism using compartmental, kinetic, mechanistic, metabolic network, or physiologically based approaches* Reconstruct and model tissue\-specific metabolic networks and validate model predictions using experimental data* through peer\-reviewed publications**Your Profile*** PhD or equivalent in computational biology, systems biology, applied mathematics, biochemical engineering, or a related field* Strong expertise in
